Let’s make something unforgettable.

20738.bio:
🌟 Akshita Swarnkar (aka Akshu)
🎨 Developer | 🎭 Creator | 🚀 Dreamer
👩🏻‍💻 A 17cm-handed coder with ultra-promax humour, self-obsession, and a mission to become a tech billionaire.

I'm a student who turns chaos into creativity and code into magic. Obsessed with painting pixels and building projects that stand out like constellations in a dark sky ✨. Whether it's designing an aesthetic web app or automating real-world problems, I believe in learning loud and dreaming bigger.
